t: This is the Royal Marsden Hospital, a specialist NHS cancer hospital, with this site in Brompton and another in Sutton. It takes its name from William Marsden, the surgeon who founded it, and also the Royal Free Hospital. Several well-known people died here. The chemist Rosalind Franklin, whose X-ray work was central to understanding the structure of DNA, was largely unrecognised in her lifetime. The actor Albert Finney died here, as did the Pop artist Pauline Boty, the only acknowledged woman among the founders of British Pop art.
